findings.title: Record loaded by URL id with no ownership check (IDOR)
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one warning security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: server.js:19
Issue: Record loaded by URL id with no ownership check (IDOR) (CWE-639, A01:2025)
What to change: Scope the query to the signed-in user (e.g. where: { id, userId: user.id }, .eq('user_id', user.id), filter_by(id=item_id, owner_id=current_user.id)) or load the record and return 404/403 when its owner is not the caller. If any user is meant to reach any record, guard the route with an admin/role check or mark the finding as ignored. To prove it live, run `deployready --active --token <user A> --token-b <user B>`: it requests user A's object with user B's token.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "93799705ca2a".
